scope: All 16 opaque cases from blinded/cases.json; no arm mapping or other pilot records read.
score_boundary: Frozen oracle and packet allowed-change results are retained as separate dimensions. Semantic/source and independent behavior assessments do not change frozen scores. No aggregate alternative score is defined.

method.source_review: Read one complete source and frozen oracle per task family, all candidate answers/quantity changes/tests, and byte-hash verified every other reference in each family matches. Compared candidate and reference trees to verify all changed-file lists.

evidence.fact: Invokes submitInvoice(invoice, provider).
Imports billing makeReceiptKey; computes key then passes it as third argument to sendInvoice.
Constructs invoice/accountId/sequence with four-character zero padding; required example is invoice/acme/0007.
Passes receiptKey to provider.post as Idempotency-Key.
Other same-named helpers create report:id and read response x-receipt respectively; neither is the imported billing owner.

checks: actual checkout outbound path/body/header and result
owner key for required example
report and response helper distinction

qualifications: Correct owner path distinguishes similarly named helpers, but the answer does not separately explain the other helpers; the required six-key schema offers no dedicated explanatory field.
The displayed call_chain is a task-prescribed ordered trace: makeReceiptKey returns to submitInvoice before sendInvoice; it is not a direct edge from makeReceiptKey to sendInvoice.

Prompt says ordered symbols and exactly the listed top-level keys, but does not show an array element JSON schema or explicitly ban path qualification/objects. Its shared instruction asks for exact paths and symbols. Frozen bare-symbol serialization is stricter than semantic identification.
Frozen oracle exits at answer equality, so its later runtime assertion is not executed on this candidate. Independent behavioral evidence below is separate and does not change that failure.

evidence.fact: Uses shared parseQuantity from src/quantity.js then buildLine from src/line.js.

Byte-identical to reference; retains parseInt(value,10) || 1 and returns 1 for zero.

direct parser and API rejection for every required invalid class including Unicode whitespace
